description: Audit remaining PR test additions and owning pre-existing suites for repeated flows, duplicate setup and exact helper reuse. Implement additional behavior-preserving candidates only when semantics and isolation match; record remaining mismatches and stop when no justified candidate remains. Validate each changed suite plus mix q and final mix precommit. No arbitrary LOC target, deleted coverage or production edits.

comments.text: Duplicate-block audit across PR tests (filtered to PR-added regions) identifies one remaining substantial exact flow: history ingress capture/admit/finalize in three new continuation/attachment scenarios. Extract a private finalize_answer helper keeping incoming identity, actor, answer and every assertion explicit. Existing capture_delivered is not reusable because it records/associates transport confirmation, a different lifecycle stage. Validate HistoryIngressTest. Other large duplicate matches are pre-existing outside this PR and remain out of scope.

History helper validated: all 28 HistoryIngress cases pass and mix q passes. Finer duplicate scan identifies the registry whitelist repeated verbatim in two existing tests, both edited by this PR to add attach_document. Consolidate into one literal expected-key module attribute; retain both API assertions and exact ordering. Do not derive expected keys from production. This is the remaining concrete duplication candidate; other short similarities have differing contracts.

Final audit: no remaining exact duplicate blocks >=8 nonblank lines / 220 characters overlap PR test additions. Semantic review retained distinct scopes: async pure notification/selection/preflight suites vs synchronous DB/global-mailer suites; real HTTP/SMTP journeys vs adapter mocks; per-request native lifecycle probe vs ordinary factory tests; DeliveryFiles and AttachDocuments are new owning modules. Smaller fixture similarities preserve different provenance/permission/transport contracts and do not justify new abstraction. Provenance/settings merge and SMTP setup scoping verified with AST body equivalence. All test scenarios retained. Net reduction this task: 97 lines; one additional standalone module removed. No worthwhile additional behavior-preserving consolidation identified within PR scope; older duplicate setup outside PR remains excluded.

Final validation passed: mix precommit, 111 cases (9 properties, 102 tests); mix q passed for every round. Final diff whitespace clean. No commits/pushes or production edits made; previously uncommitted notify_person edits preserved.

title: [zaq-6r7] Audit remaining tests and complete worthwhile consolidation
